Black Friday · November 27, 2026

Midnight Sale

Twenty-five real Black Friday deals, each checked today at its store. Every card shows the sale price, the usual price, the discount, when the price was checked and where it was read — plus an honest signal: a new low, a strong price, or a solid deal, with the evidence for it.

Prices checked November 27, 2026 (UTC). Prices move during Black Friday week — the store link opens the store’s search for the exact product, so confirm the price there before you buy.

How the signals work: New low means the lowest price the product has ever been offered for, as reported by the source named on the deal. Strong price means a cut of about 30% or more, or a large dollar saving on a current model. Solid deal means a real cut worth taking, but a modest one — often the first cut on a brand-new product. A percentage alone never decides it: the evidence on each deal says why.

Midnight Sale is an independent deal finder. Prices were read at the stores and deals sources named on each deal on November 27, 2026. Store links go to the store’s own search for the product named.
